_about: Starter knowledge (version 3). Short summaries written for this demo from public MoHFW ASHA training modules, HBNC / IMNCI guidance and WHO fact sheets. Not a substitute for official protocols or clinical judgement; every item ends with when to refer. Each approved answer lists alternative phrasings; every phrasing is stored as its own vector pointing to the same answer (semantic answer cache).

protocols.title: Newborn danger signs
protocols.text: Refer a newborn to the nearest facility immediately if any of these are present: not able to feed or suck well, convulsions (fits), fast breathing (60 or more breaths per minute), severe chest indrawing, body feels cold or very hot, no movement unless stimulated, yellow palms or soles, bleeding from the umbilical stump or pus/redness spreading around it. नवजात में ये खतरे के संकेत हों तो तुरंत अस्पताल भेजें।

protocols.title: Keeping the newborn warm
protocols.text: Dry the baby, keep skin-to-skin contact with the mother (kangaroo care), cover the head, delay bathing. A baby whose feet feel cold needs warming; if the baby stays cold or stops feeding, refer. शिशु को माँ की छाती से लगाकर गर्म रखें।

protocols.title: Pregnancy danger signs
protocols.text: Refer a pregnant woman urgently for: vaginal bleeding, convulsions, severe headache with blurred vision, high blood pressure (140/90 or more), swelling of face and hands, severe abdominal pain, fever, reduced or no fetal movement, leaking of water. Arrange transport (108/102) and inform the ANM. गर्भवती को खून बहना, झटके, तेज सिर दर्द हो तो तुरंत रेफर करें।

protocols.title: Routine antenatal care
protocols.text: Encourage at least four ANC check-ups, blood pressure and weight at each visit, iron-folic acid (IFA) tablets daily, calcium, two Td injections (or one booster if vaccinated in the last three years), and planning for institutional delivery. गर्भावस्था में कम से कम चार जांच और रोज़ IFA गोली।

protocols.title: Diarrhoea in children: ORS and zinc
protocols.text: Give ORS after every loose stool and zinc for 14 days; continue breastfeeding and feeding. Refer if the child is lethargic, cannot drink, has sunken eyes, skin pinch goes back very slowly, has blood in stool, or diarrhoea lasts 14 days or more. दस्त में ORS और 14 दिन ज़िंक दें।

protocols.title: Fever in children
protocols.text: Check for danger signs, stiff neck, rash and breathing. In malaria-endemic areas test with an RDT. Give paracetamol for high fever and fluids. Refer if fever lasts more than 7 days, the child is under 2 months, or any danger sign is present. बच्चे को 7 दिन से ज़्यादा बुखार हो तो रेफर करें।

protocols.title: Fever with rash: suspected measles
protocols.source: WHO measles fact sheet / MR surveillance (summary)
protocols.text: Fever with a red rash, plus cough, runny nose or red eyes, may be measles. Report every suspected case to the ANM for surveillance, check MR vaccination of all children nearby, give vitamin A as advised, and refer if there is difficulty breathing, dehydration or convulsions. बुखार और दाने वाले हर केस की सूचना दें।

protocols.title: Cough for more than two weeks
protocols.text: Anyone with cough for two weeks or more, fever, night sweats or weight loss is a presumptive TB case: refer for sputum test (free under NTEP) and support treatment adherence. दो हफ्ते से ज़्यादा खांसी हो तो बलगम की जांच करवाएं।

protocols.title: Jaundice
protocols.text: Yellow eyes and dark urine suggest jaundice. Advise safe drinking water and rest, avoid unprescribed medicines, and refer for testing. Refer urgently if the person is confused, very drowsy, bleeding, or pregnant. Several cases in one area may mean contaminated water: inform the ANM. आंखें पीली हों तो साफ़ पानी, आराम और जांच; गर्भवती हो तो तुरंत रेफर करें।

protocols.title: Routine immunisation schedule (infant)
protocols.text: Birth: BCG, OPV-0, Hepatitis B birth dose. 6, 10 and 14 weeks: OPV, Pentavalent and Rotavirus; fIPV at 6 and 14 weeks; PCV at 6 and 14 weeks where introduced. 9-12 months: MR-1, PCV booster, JE-1 (endemic districts), vitamin A first dose. 16-24 months: MR-2, DPT booster, OPV booster, JE-2. Track due lists and follow up children who missed doses. जन्म पर BCG, OPV-0 और हेपेटाइटिस B; 9 महीने पर खसरा-रूबेला (MR-1) का टीका।

protocols.title: Signs of severe dehydration
protocols.text: Two or more of: lethargic or unconscious, sunken eyes, not able to drink or drinking poorly, skin pinch goes back very slowly. This is an emergency: refer immediately and give ORS sips on the way if the child can drink. बच्चा सुस्त हो, आंखें धंसी हों या पी न पाए तो तुरंत रेफर करें, रास्ते में ORS दें।

protocols.title: When cases cluster
protocols.text: If you see several similar illnesses in a short time (for example fever with rash, loose motions, jaundice) in one village, inform the ANM the same day. Note ages and households, encourage safe water and hygiene, and follow any district alert instructions. एक गाँव में कई मिलते-जुलते केस हों तो उसी दिन ANM को बताएं।

protocols.title: Danger signs after delivery
protocols.text: After delivery, refer the mother immediately (call 108/102) if there is heavy bleeding (soaking a pad in a few minutes or passing large clots), fits, fever with foul-smelling discharge, severe headache or blurred vision, difficulty breathing, or severe pain or swelling in one leg. Visit on days 1, 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 and 42 after a home delivery. प्रसव के बाद ज़्यादा खून, झटके या तेज़ बुखार हो तो तुरंत अस्पताल भेजें।

protocols.title: Anaemia in pregnancy and IFA tablets
protocols.text: Every pregnant woman should take one iron and folic acid (IFA) tablet daily from the fourth month for at least 180 days, and continue for 180 days after delivery. Take it after food, not with tea. Encourage green leafy vegetables, pulses and jaggery. Check haemoglobin at every antenatal visit. Refer if she is very pale, breathless at rest, or haemoglobin is below 7 g/dL. गर्भवती रोज़ एक आयरन की गोली खाए; बहुत कमज़ोरी या सांस फूले तो रेफर करें।

protocols.title: Fast breathing in children: possible pneumonia
protocols.text: Count breaths for one full minute while the child is calm. Fast breathing is 60 or more (under 2 months), 50 or more (2 to 12 months) or 40 or more (1 to 5 years). A child with cough and fast breathing needs to see the ANM or doctor the same day. Refer immediately if there is chest indrawing, the child cannot drink, is very sleepy, or has fits. बच्चे की सांस तेज़ हो या पसली चले तो उसी दिन दिखाएं, पसली धंसे तो तुरंत रेफर करें।

protocols.title: Fever with mosquitoes: malaria and dengue
protocols.text: For any fever during the mosquito season, do a malaria rapid test if you have kits and start treatment only as per the result and protocol. For suspected dengue give paracetamol and plenty of fluids; do not give aspirin or ibuprofen. Refer urgently if there is severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, bleeding from gums or nose, black stools, or the person is very weak or restless. Remove standing water around homes. मच्छर वाले मौसम में बुखार हो तो जांच करें; खून आए या पेट में तेज़ दर्द हो तो तुरंत रेफर करें।

protocols.title: Malnutrition in children (MUAC)
protocols.text: Measure mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) for children aged 6 to 59 months. Red (below 11.5 cm) or swelling of both feet means severe acute malnutrition: refer to the Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre. Yellow (11.5 to 12.5 cm) means moderate malnutrition: counsel on feeding and link with the Anganwadi. Refer immediately if a malnourished child also has fever, diarrhoea or is not eating. बांह का नाप लाल हो या दोनों पैरों में सूजन हो तो पोषण पुनर्वास केंद्र भेजें।

protocols.title: Breastfeeding
protocols.text: Start breastfeeding within one hour of birth and give the first milk (colostrum). Give only breast milk for six months: no water, honey, ghutti or animal milk. From six months add soft home food and continue breastfeeding up to two years. If the baby cannot suck or feed, that is a danger sign: refer. जन्म के एक घंटे में स्तनपान शुरू करें और छह महीने तक सिर्फ़ मां का दूध दें।

protocols.title: Snake bite
protocols.text: Keep the person calm and still. Keep the bitten limb still, like a fracture, and remove rings, bangles or tight clothing. Do not cut the wound, suck it, tie a tight band, apply ice or use herbal remedies. Take the person immediately to a facility that has anti-snake venom (call 108) and note the time of the bite. सांप काटे तो अंग को हिलने न दें, काटें या चूसें नहीं, तुरंत 108 से अस्पताल ले जाएं।

protocols.title: Dog bite and rabies
protocols.text: Wash the wound at once with soap and running water for 15 minutes, then apply an antiseptic. Do not apply chilli, turmeric, oil or tight bandages. Send the person the same day to the PHC for anti-rabies vaccine; deep or bleeding bites also need immunoglobulin. All vaccine doses must be completed. कुत्ते के काटने पर घाव को 15 मिनट साबुन-पानी से धोएं और उसी दिन रेबीज़ का टीका लगवाएं।

protocols.title: Burns
protocols.text: Cool the burn under clean running water for 20 minutes. Remove rings and clothing that are not stuck to the skin. Cover loosely with a clean cloth. Do not apply ice, toothpaste, oil, ghee or ink. Refer if the burn is larger than the person's palm, is on the face, hands, feet, genitals or joints, is from electricity or chemicals, or the person is a young child or elderly. जलने पर 20 मिनट साफ़ पानी डालें, कुछ और न लगाएं; बड़ा या चेहरे का जला हो तो रेफर करें।

protocols.title: Pesticide or poison swallowed
protocols.text: Move the person away from the poison, remove contaminated clothing and wash the skin with water. Do not make the person vomit and do not give anything by mouth if drowsy. If drowsy, lay them on their side. Keep the container or label to show the doctor. Take them to hospital immediately (call 108). ज़हर या कीटनाशक पी लिया हो तो उल्टी न कराएं, डिब्बा साथ लेकर तुरंत 108 से अस्पताल ले जाएं।

protocols.title: Heat stroke
protocols.text: Move the person to shade, loosen clothing, and cool them with wet cloths and fanning. If fully awake, give sips of water or ORS. Refer urgently (call 108) if the person is confused, unconscious, has fits, or has very hot dry skin. Prevent: drink water often, avoid work in the afternoon sun, cover the head. लू लगे तो छांव में लिटाएं, गीले कपड़े से ठंडा करें; बेहोशी या झटके हों तो तुरंत 108।

answers.title: Newborn not feeding — what should I do?
answers.text: Not feeding is a danger sign. Keep the baby warm (skin-to-skin), do not give anything other than breast milk, and arrange immediate referral to the nearest facility (call 108/102). Inform the ANM. नवजात दूध नहीं पी रहा है तो तुरंत रेफर करें।

answers.title: How much ORS to give a child with diarrhoea?
answers.text: Under 2 years: 50-100 ml (a quarter to half cup) after each loose stool. 2 years and older: 100-200 ml after each stool. Give slowly with a spoon; continue breastfeeding. Give zinc for 14 days. Refer if danger signs appear. 2 साल से छोटे बच्चे को हर दस्त के बाद आधा कप, बड़े को एक कप ORS दें और 14 दिन ज़िंक।

answers.title: Pregnant woman has high BP and headache
answers.text: BP 140/90 or more with headache, blurred vision or swelling can be pre-eclampsia. Refer urgently to the FRU/CHC with transport (108). Do not wait for the next visit. Inform the ANM. गर्भवती को तेज़ सिर दर्द और बीपी ज़्यादा हो तो तुरंत रेफर करें।

answers.title: Child has fever and rash — is it measles?
answers.text: Fever with rash plus cough, runny nose or red eyes is a suspected measles case. Report it to the ANM today, check MR vaccination of children in the household and neighbourhood, and refer if breathing is difficult or the child is dehydrated. बुखार और दाने हों तो आज ही ANM को बताएं और आसपास के बच्चों का MR टीका जांचें।
alt_questions: बुखार और दाने खसरा तो नहीं

answers.title: Where to send someone with long cough?
answers.text: Cough of 2 weeks or more: refer to the nearest PHC/DMC for a free sputum test under NTEP. Note the name in your register and follow up the result. दो हफ्ते से ज़्यादा खांसी हो तो PHC पर मुफ़्त बलगम जांच के लिए भेजें।
alt_questions: लंबी खांसी की जांच कहाँ होगी

answers.title: Child has high fever — paracetamol dose?
answers.text: Give paracetamol by weight as per your drug kit chart, not more than 4 times a day, and plenty of fluids. Children under 2 months with fever must be referred. Refer if fever lasts more than 7 days or any danger sign is present. पैरासिटामोल वज़न के हिसाब से, दिन में 4 बार से ज़्यादा नहीं; 2 महीने से छोटे बच्चे को रेफर करें।

answers.title: Someone bitten by a snake — what to do?
answers.text: Keep the person calm and the limb still. Do not cut, suck or tie a tight band. Remove bangles or rings. Take them to hospital with anti-snake venom right away (call 108) and note the time of the bite. सांप काटे तो अंग स्थिर रखें, काटें या चूसें नहीं, तुरंत 108 से अस्पताल ले जाएं।

answers.text: Wash the wound with soap and running water for 15 minutes and apply antiseptic. Do not put chilli, turmeric or oil. Send the person to the PHC the same day for anti-rabies vaccine and complete all doses. कुत्ते के काटने पर घाव धोएं और उसी दिन रेबीज़ का टीका लगवाएं।

answers.title: Child got burnt — first aid?
answers.text: Cool the burn under clean running water for 20 minutes and cover it with a clean cloth. Do not apply toothpaste, ice, oil or ghee. Refer if it is bigger than the child's palm, on the face, hands or genitals, or from electricity. जले हुए हिस्से पर 20 मिनट पानी डालें; बड़ा जला हो तो रेफर करें।

answers.title: Someone drank pesticide — what to do?
answers.text: Do not make them vomit. Remove contaminated clothes, wash the skin, lay them on their side if drowsy, and take them to hospital immediately with the container (call 108). कीटनाशक पी लिया हो तो उल्टी न कराएं, डिब्बा साथ लेकर तुरंत अस्पताल ले जाएं।

answers.title: Heat stroke — what to do?
answers.text: Move the person to shade, loosen clothes, cool with wet cloths and fanning, and give sips of water or ORS if awake. If confused, unconscious or having fits, call 108 now. लू लगे तो छांव में ठंडा करें; बेहोशी हो तो तुरंत 108।

answers.title: Child has cough and fast breathing
answers.text: Count breaths for a full minute. Fast breathing with cough means the child must see the ANM or doctor today. If the chest pulls in, the child cannot drink or is very sleepy, refer immediately (call 108). खांसी के साथ सांस तेज़ हो तो आज ही दिखाएं; पसली धंसे तो तुरंत रेफर करें।

answers.title: Child looks very thin or MUAC is red
answers.text: Measure MUAC for children aged 6 to 59 months. Red (below 11.5 cm) or swelling of both feet means severe acute malnutrition: refer to the Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre, urgently if the child also has fever, diarrhoea or is not eating. Yellow (11.5 to 12.5 cm): counsel on feeding and link with the Anganwadi. बांह का नाप लाल हो या दोनों पैरों में सूजन हो तो पोषण पुनर्वास केंद्र भेजें।
